Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on header, overlays, or floating menus without solid backdrop-blur or opacity background.
All form inquiries must submit to the backend endpoint and display a clear confirmation state targeting info@infinitiveshealthcare.com.
Do NOT mention Nutriedge anywhere in the application; replace all branding strictly with Infinitives Healthcare ('Excellence in Every Dose').
Follow generous spacing (p-8 to p-24) to create an ultra-luxurious, Awwwards-winning nutraceutical factory site.
Keep designated empty space cards with badges for 'Official Plant Address to be added' as requested by client.
